title: Trembling-Hand Perfection in Mean Field Games
summary: We introduce an admissible trembling-hand refinement for stochastic mean field games formulated through relaxed controlled martingale problems. A relaxed MFG equilibrium is perfect if it is the common Wasserstein limit of two sequences of joint control-state laws. The first consists of full-support population perturbations admissible for the state laws they generate; the second consists of exact optimal responses to those perturbed state laws.
